summary.en: Protect yourself first. Move away from furniture and windows and protect your head, for example under a sturdy table. Do not force yourself to put out a fire while it is shaking. Do not run outside straight away. When the shaking stops, check for fire, injuries, building damage and your escape route. Near the sea or rivers, watch out for a tsunami.
